$comment: Dependency audit waivers (SECURE_CODING_STANDARDS, Pipeline; SEC-034). Each is dated, names the finding, the reason, the owner and an expiry, and is approved by the reviewer. scripts/check/audit-waivers.ts enforces them in CI: a waiver covers one advisory, in one package, only along the listed paths, until it expires; an expired waiver or one that matches nothing fails the build.
